name: Bravo Mining Corp.
summary: Bravo Mining Corp. acquires, explores, operates, and develops mineral properties. The company explores for palladium, platinum, rhodium, gold, and nickel deposits. It primarily holds a 100% interest in the Luanga project covering an area of 7,810 hectares and Canaã Copper project covering an area of 6,185 hectares located in the Carajás Mineral Province, Pará State, Brazil. Canaã Copper operates an exploration project containing drill-intercepted Cu-Au mineralization at the Tapuia and Gueroba prospects. The company was formerly known as BPG Metals Corp. and changed its name to Bravo Mining Corp. in May 2022. Bravo Mining Corp. is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
